description: Guides the design, implementation, registration, budgeting, and debugging of Clypra's multi-tier caching infrastructure across both Rust native disk caching (UnifiedDiskCacheManager) and TypeScript in-memory caching (CacheCoordinator). Use when adding cache namespaces, registering cache participants, configuring LRU eviction weights, optimizing RAM/VRAM allocations, debugging cache invalidation or memory leaks, or integrating new media subsystems.
